title: A Morning with a Baker
text:
Lena is a baker in a small town by the sea. In this interview, she talks about her early mornings. She starts work at four o'clock every day. Her bread is famous in the town.

The interviewer asks her why she likes her job. Lena says that she enjoys making bread for her neighbours. She also says that the smell of fresh bread makes her happy. At the end, she gives advice to young people: work hard and be kind to your customers.

questions.text: What time does Lena start work?
Why does Lena like her job?
options: She enjoys making bread for her neighbours.
She wants to move to a big city.

questions.text: What kind of person is Lena, based on the passage?
options: She is shy and never talks.
She does not care about her customers.

questions.text: Why does Lena give advice to young people?
options: She wants to share what she has learned.
She wants them to leave the town.

vocabulary.definition: a meeting where someone asks questions to find out about a person
people who buy things from a shop or business
suggestions about what someone should do

paragraph_translations: Lena, sahil kenarındaki küçük bir kasabada fırıncı. Bu röportajda erken saatlerdeki işinden bahsediyor. Her gün saat dörtte işe başlıyor. Ekmekleri kasabada ünlü.

Röportaj yapan kişi ona işini neden sevdiğini soruyor. Lena komşularına ekmek yapmaktan zevk aldığını söylüyor. Taze ekmeğin kokusunun onu mutlu ettiğini de ekliyor. En sonda genç insanlara tavsiye veriyor: çok çalışın ve müşterilerinize karşı nazik olun.
